reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DSH 提供一个 DeepSeek 网页版模型接入源，用户可在 DSH 中选择 DeepSeek 快速/专家/识图模型进行对话与工具调用。依据说明文档与仓库结构，可确认其通过本地网关启动并驱动 Chrome 与网页版交互实现 OpenAI 兼容转换，但该机制依赖外部网页 UI 与登录会话，属于中等风险外部服务集成。

summaries.zh: 该插件将 DeepSeek 网页版接入 DSH，作为本地可用的 OpenAI 兼容模型提供方，提供持续对话与工具调用能力。
summaries.en: This plugin connects DeepSeek web (chat.deepseek.com) into DSH as a local OpenAI-compatible LLM provider, enabling chat and tool-calling workflows through a local gateway.

capabilities: Local HTTP gateway integration with DSH as an OpenAI-style endpoint
Browser automation of DeepSeek web UI via local Chrome
Tool-call parsing and forwarding from model output to DSH
Session-based login workflow relying on DeepSeek account credentials/cookies
Concurrent sub-agent handling through separate browser pages

reasons.code: README states the plugin auto-starts a gateway on localhost (5688) and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, introducing local network/service exposure.
Files listed in tree/resources show a browser driver and gateway architecture, indicating automation against chat.deepseek.com with external UI dependency.
README explicitly marks the project as Developer Preview with limited verification for scenarios like long multi-round tool loops and reconnection behavior.
